name: @thetis/prompt-cache
description: Advises the provider on prompt caching and records where the cached prefix breaks.

enabled.help: false puts the strategy off in the hint for every model.

ttl.help: Lifetime of the conversation breakpoints, 5m or 1h; left out of the hint when unset, so the provider's policy applies.

systemTtl.help: Lifetime of the system prefix breakpoint, 5m or 1h; left out of the hint when unset.

anchorStride.help: Positions between the anchor breakpoints, 0 for no anchors; left out of the hint when unset.

maxBreakpoints.help: Upper bound on breakpoints in one request, clamped to 4 by the provider; left out of the hint when unset.

explicitVendors.help: Vendors that get the strategy breakpoints, every other vendor automatic; unset, the provider's own list (anthropic) applies.

overrides.help: Per-vendor or per-model settings keyed by vendor name or model id prefix, longest key wins, with values strategy, ttl, systemTtl, anchorStride and maxBreakpoints.

diagnostics.help: Record prefix fingerprints in the harness and log a turn that rewrites the cached prefix.

affinity.help: Put a stable per-user token in the hint, which the provider sends as the OpenRouter user field.
